working_definition: Author cell type 'adult lamina epithelial/marginal glial cell' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 984 cells): lamina glia, grouped call of epithelial and marginal glial cells; authors' terms FBbt:00100513 and FBbt:00005722.
searches_performed: ancestors of both members via EBI OLS4

best_match.fbbt_term: adult lamina neuropil associated glial cell
best_match.fbbt_definition: Glial cell located in the lamina neuropil (Kremer et al., 2017).

justification: Grouped call. Both adult lamina epithelial glial cell and adult lamina marginal glial cell have adult lamina neuropil associated glial cell as an ancestor (verified), and it is the most specific common parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Astrocyte-like (reticular) glial cell of the adult lamina.
Specialized ensheathing glial cell of the lamina.

recommendation: Broad match to the common parent; members listed.
